artworks.title: Cyparissus
artworks.description: Vignali's Strasbourg canvas: the youth mourns the tame stag he has slain — grief Apollo will root as the cypress.

artworks.title: Metamorphosis of Cyparissus (House of the Vettii)
artworks.description: Pompeian fresco: Cyparissus beside the stag whose death will turn him into the funeral evergreen.

artworks.title: Apollo and Cyparissus
artworks.description: Dutch Ovid engraving: Apollo with Cyparissus and the doomed stag — pastoral friendship before the accidental shot.

artworks.title: Cyparissus Changed into a Cypress
artworks.description: Rijksmuseum climax: the boy becomes the cypress — endless mourning made evergreen.

popCulture.title: Cyparissus
popCulture.description: The boy who killed his stag and became the mourning cypress — Apollo's other beloved tree of grief.
